description: This file defines the MetricsLogger class, which extends BaseTracer to provide logging functionalities for different stages of runs (chain, LLM, tool, agent) using a Winston logger. It includes methods for handling start, end, error events, and utility functions for managing run hierarchies and breadcrumbs.

classes.name: MetricsLogger
classes.description: A class extending BaseTracer to log detailed run events and hierarchies for chains, LLMs, tools, and agents.

methods.name: persistRun
methods.description: A protected method that resolves immediately, likely a placeholder for persisting run data.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Retrieves the parent runs of a given run by traversing parent_run_id links.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Generates a breadcrumb string representing the hierarchy of runs.

methods.name: onChainStart
methods.description: Logs the start of a chain run with input details.

methods.name: onChainEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a chain run with output details.

methods.name: onChainError
methods.description: Logs an error occurring during a chain run.

methods.name: onLLMStart
methods.description: Logs the start of an LLM run, including prompts if present.

methods.name: onLLMEnd
methods.description: Logs the completion of an LLM run with output details.

methods.name: onLLMError
methods.description: Logs an error during an LLM run.

methods.name: onToolStart
methods.description: Logs the start of a tool run with input details.

methods.name: onToolEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a tool run with output details.

methods.name: onToolError
methods.description: Logs an error during a tool run.

methods.name: onAgentAction
methods.description: Logs the action selected by an agent during its run.
